globalSearch-instructions-description: Searches can include operators għal refine il- search.  Operators huma specified by writing il- operator isem u value separated by a colon.  For example, an operator specification ta’ `lista:Blocked` would limit il- search għal kards that huma contained ġewwa a lista named *Blocked*.  If il- value contains spaces jew special characters it must be enclosed ġewwa quotation marks (e.g. `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).

globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - where *<field>* huwa one ta’ `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` or `__predicate_member__`.  Placing a `-` in front ta’ *<field>* searches għal il- absence ta’ a value ġewwa that field (e.g. `has:-due` searches għal kards without a due date).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - where *<sort-name>* huwa one ta’ `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` or `__predicate_modified__`.  For a descending sort, place a `-` in front ta’ il- sort isem.

globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: Traduzzjoni Maltija: Multiple operators may be specified.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Similar operators huma *OR*ed together.  Kards that match any ta’ il- conditions will be returned.
`__operator_list__:Disponibbli __operator_list__:Blocked` would return kards contained ġewwa any lista named *Blocked* or *Disponibbli*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Differing operators huma *AND*ed together.  Only kards that match all ta’ il- differing operators huma returned.  `__operator_list__:Disponibbli __operator_label__:red` returns biss kards ġewwa il- lista *Disponibbli* with a *red* label.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Days can be specified as a positive jew negative integer jew using `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` or `__predicate_year__` għal il- current period.

database-migration-description: Migrate text-based data (everything except attachments u avatars, which stay fuq il- filesystem) between MongoDB u FerretDB v1 (SQLite). The other database must be running u reachable (default ports: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; override ma’ WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). After it finishes, point MONGO_URL fi il- other database u restart WeKan (on Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb or =mongodb).

sandstorm-migration-description: When WeKan runs inside a Sandstorm grain, its old MongoDB 3 database huwa migrated għal FerretDB v1 (SQLite) on first launch, and attachments u avatars huma mexxa minn il- database għal il- grain's files/attachments u files/avatars directories. Dan shows whether that migration succeeded u how much disk space il- old raw MongoDB database files still use inside il- grain, and lets you delete those raw files għal free space.

sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Ħassar il- raw MongoDB 3 database files għal free disk space? The data has already been migrated għal FerretDB u il- filesystem. Dan cannot be undone.

cards-loading-description: WeKan loads bord kards automatically: a big bord (over il- size threshold) loads biss il- kards currently visible (infinite scroll) plus a live count, so it stays fast u uses less memory u bandwidth, while smaller bordijiet load every kard għal il- simplest, fully featured experience. There huwa nothing għal configure. Operators can still force a mode ma’ il- CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) and CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD environment variables.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Lazy kard loading huwa experimental: kard counters u WIP limits huma accurate, but il- Calendar/Table/Gantt views u multi-select reflect biss il- kards loaded so far. Reload open bordijiet after changing dan.
render-links-as-plain-text: Traduzzjoni Maltija: Render links as plain text
render-links-as-plain-text-description: When enabled, all links (both markdown links like [label](url) and raw HTML <a href> tags) huma always shown as plain, non-clickable text ġewwa every rich text field (bord u kard titles, descriptions, kummenti, checklists, etc.). Dan prevents misleading clickable links. Predefinit huwa off, so links stay clickable.
always-show-code-as-text: Traduzzjoni Maltija: Always show all code as plain text
always-show-code-as-text-description: When enabled, rich text huwa never rendered as markdown jew HTML: il- entire source huwa always shown as plain text ġewwa every rich text field (bord u kard titles, descriptions, kummenti, checklists, etc.). Dan reveals hidden content — HTML kummenti (<!-- -->), il- target ta’ markdown links, JavaScript u any other code — so all code huwa always visible, mhux clickable, and mhux running. Predefinit huwa off, so markdown huwa rendered normally.
disable-all-import-description: When enabled, all import features huma turned off: importing a bord minn WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea u Forgejo, as well as cloning a bord. The import menu options huma hidden u il- server rejects any import request. Predefinit huwa off.
disable-all-export-description: When enabled, all export features huma turned off: exporting a bord as WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, or għal NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, and single-attachment export. The export menu options huma hidden u il- server rejects any export request. Predefinit huwa off.
disable-import-avatars-description: When enabled, avatars (utent profile pictures) huma never importa. Dan covers WeKan JSON import, Trello import, and avatar sync minn external identity providers fuq login (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Names u other data huma still importa; only avatars huma skipped. Predefinit huwa off.
disable-export-avatars-description: When enabled, avatars (utent profile pictures) huma never included when exporting a bord (WeKan JSON u CSV export). Usernames u other data huma still exported; only avatars huma omitted. Predefinit huwa off.
anonymize-import-users-description: When enabled, importing a WeKan JSON bord replaces every importa utent's username, full isem u initials ma’ counter placeholders (user1, user2, ...), drops their avatar, and rewrites @username mentions (and il- requested-by / assigned-by fields) inside importa kard u kumment content. Le real utent identity minn il- source bord huwa stored. The word "utent" follows il- language ta’ il- person importing. Predefinit huwa off.
anonymize-export-users-description: When enabled, exporting a bord replaces every exported utent's username, full isem u initials ma’ counter placeholders (user1, user2, ...), drops their avatar, and rewrites @username mentions (and il- requested-by / assigned-by fields) inside kard u kumment content. The exported file carries no real utent identity. The word "utent" follows il- language ta’ il- person exporting. Predefinit huwa off.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Żgur li trid tanonimizza dan il-kont? Dan jibdel għal dejjem l-isem tal-utent, l-isem sħiħ, u l-indirizz elettroniku b'valuri anonimi, ineħħi l-avatar, u jiddiżattiva d-dħul. B'differenza mit-tħassir, il-boards, il-karti u l-kummenti jżommu l-istorja tagħhom u jkomplu juru dan il-kont, iżda anonimizzat. Din l-azzjoni ma tistax titreġġa' lura.
disable-activities-description: When enabled, activity-feed entries huma never recorded u never shown anywhere (bord sidebar u kard activity tab). Le history ta’ who did what huwa kept. Predefinit huwa off.
disable-notifications-description: When enabled, WeKan never sends watch notifications (in-app, email jew other services) għal any activity. Activities can still be recorded (unless also disabled above); only il- notifications huma suppressed. Predefinit huwa off.
disable-watch-description: When enabled, il- watch feature huwa turned off — utenti cannot subscribe għal bordijiet, listi jew kards għal receive notifications, and any attempt għal change a watch level huwa rejected. Predefinit huwa off.
backup-description: Back up Attachments, Avatars and/or Data (all text-based collections that huma mhux attachments jew avatars). The .zip huwa streamed directly għal il- selected storage — no temporary file — as backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, containing YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars and /data. Cloud storages (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) use il- credentials configured ġewwa their storage tabs.
backup-scope-description: The whole instance, or one Organizzazzjoni. An Organizzazzjoni's backup contains its bordijiet u everything fuq them, including il- attachments ta’ those bordijiet — but no utent accounts u no instance settings, because those huma shared by every Organizzazzjoni. Restoring an Organizzazzjoni's backup biss ever writes għal bordijiet that Organizzazzjoni owns.
